title: Blueprint module tree
description: Schema for module_tree.json — the registry of modules the blueprint layer composes per-module overviews from. The file is scaffolded once from source layout, then treated as authored content (refined, not auto-replaced). Each entry pins a module's identity, layer, responsibility, and dependency edges; the blueprint layer walks depends_on edges to resolve cross-module orientation questions before descending into source.

version.description: Schema version of this module_tree.json. Forward-compatible (additive only).

modules.description: Module registry. Each entry corresponds to one overview.md the blueprint layer composes. Order is not semantically meaningful; consumers SHOULD sort by package_path before rendering.

provenance.description: Baseline attribution — both fields trace to a git baseline (NO wall-clock timestamp), so two runs on the same commit produce the same values.

extract_commit_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD at scaffold time.

captured_at.description: Committer date of extract_commit_sha (git log -1 --format=%cI). NOT time.Now().

package_path.description: Canonical import path or repository-relative path to the module. Acts as the unique key.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown as the overview.md H1 and in navigation.

layer.description: Architectural layer. presentation = user-facing surface (CLI, HTTP, TUI); domain = business logic; infrastructure = cross-cutting platform (config, logging, IO); measurement = observability / metrics / telemetry.

responsibility.description: One-sentence responsibility statement. Answers 'what does this module do?' without reference to other modules.

depends_on.description: package_path values of modules this module directly depends on. The blueprint layer follows these edges in dependency-order when answering cross-module orientation questions.
